cue.en: Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.

rationale.en: A base that is too narrow or too wide slows the first step.

cue.en: Soften your knees so you are ready to move.

rationale.en: Straight knees delay the split step.

cue.en: Keep your shoulders level over your hips.

rationale.en: Lateral lean shifts weight off the balls of the feet.

cue.en: Load the front knee a little more as you reach.

rationale.en: Controlled knee flexion absorbs the lunge and sets up the push back.

cue.en: Keep your front knee tracking over your foot.

rationale.en: Knee drifting inward or outward loads the joint unevenly.

cue.en: Stay taller through the chest as you lunge.

rationale.en: Excess forward lean makes the recovery slower.

cue.en: Push back to base faster after the lunge.

rationale.en: Quick recovery keeps you ready for the next shuttle.

cue.en: Reach with a longer racket arm at the bottom of the lunge.

rationale.en: Arm extension increases reach without extra lunge depth.

cue.en: Let your legs start the lunge before the racket arm reaches.

rationale.en: Leg-led sequencing keeps balance through the reach.

cue.en: Meet the shuttle higher in front of you.

rationale.en: Higher contact gives more net options.

AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT.en: Two people are in view. Please make sure only you are in the frame.

FRAMING_INVALID.en: Step back so your whole body, including your feet, is visible.

MISSING_JOINT.en: Some joints are hidden. Keep your full body in view.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.en: Tracking is unsteady. Improve lighting and face the camera.

VIEW_INVALID.en: This check needs a different camera angle; it is paused for now.

TIME_GAP.en: Tracking paused. Resume when you are ready.

TRACK_CHANGED.en: Lost track of you for a moment. Checks restart now.

HANDEDNESS_UNKNOWN.en: Set your racket hand in the session setup to enable arm checks.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.en: Racket tracking is not active, so contact checks are off.

CONTACT_UNOBSERVED.en: Shuttle contact cannot be seen from body tracking alone.
